name: Jinzo - Energy Shocker
effectText: This card's name becomes "Jinzo" while on the field or in the GY. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can destroy all Traps your opponent controls (if face-down, reveal it), then this card gains 300 ATK for each card destroyed. You can only use this effect of "Jinzo - Energy Shocker" once per turn. While you have another monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" in your field or GY, your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards or effects.
